# Habitat for Humanity Halton-Mississauga-Dufferin

> > Habitat HMD builds affordable homes and strengthens communities across Halton, Mississauga, and Dufferin through donations, volunteering, and partnerships.

Habitat for Humanity Halton-Mississauga-Dufferin (Habitat HMD) is a nonprofit organization dedicated to eliminating substandard housing and building community strength in the Greater Toronto Area. The organization operates the ReStore thrift store, manages homeownership programs, and engages thousands of donors and volunteers annually.

## Ways to Give

- [Monthly Giving - Habitat for Humanity Halton-Mississauga-Dufferin](https://habitathmd.ca/monthly-giving): Hope Builders monthly donor program for recurring donations
- [Leave A Legacy - Habitat for Humanity Halton-Mississauga-Dufferin](https://habitathmd.ca/leave-a-legacy): Legacy and estate planning giving guide for donors
- [Cars for Habitat Homes - Habitat for Humanity Halton-Mississauga-Dufferin](https://habitathmd.ca/cars-for-habitat-homes): Vehicle donation program for cars, trucks, and motorcycles
